uses_memory_ids: memory_b2 (Regional failover restored latency fast during the March degradation; traffic shifted cleanly and error rates recovered within minutes.)
memory_b4 (Circuit breakers on the payments dependency contained a partner outage; failing fast preserved the rest of the checkout path.)
answer.rationale: memory_b2 shows that regional failover successfully restored latency during a prior March degradation with clean traffic shift and quick error rate recovery. memory_b4 confirms circuit breakers can contain dependency outages. With p99 write latency at 5x target and degradation confined to the primary region, failing over to a healthy region is the fastest way to restore writes while settlement traffic peaks. Circuit breakers would help if the root cause is a downstream dependency, but the region confinement suggests the issue is infrastructure-local. Failover has the clearest path to sustaining availability and protecting writes under peak load.
